_doc: trivialBudgetShare was 0.4 of a budget that is now 1.4x longer (generator timeTargetK), so 0.4 / 1.4 keeps the same absolute finish-time cut.
_ladder: ladderLeftMin: the reference bot must leave at least this much salvage of turret ladder (towers, Lv2, Lv3) unbought on average, so there is always something to build until a defend level ends (Batch 3).
_variety: Variety rule (outpost-ops#150): a generated level whose signature (modules, goal, template, layout entities on a grid x grid map cut, beat order) matches any earlier level in the pack is a duplicate; no window. exempt: level ids never checked and never matched. maxPasses: pack-build passes that rebuild duplicates.
_playShape: enforce false (2026-11-17, 151.3): report-only. Beats follow Doug's rule (chat 2026-11-17): every wave is a beat, repeats included; in the bot's action stream a repeating cycle of 4 or fewer actions registers nothing after its first pass, a step that breaks it is a beat, a cycle of 5 or more counts each pass (bots shape.ts shapeBeatsResult). With that sheet the late-beat limit no longer rejects anything and beat types rarely do, but the phase limit still rejects most harvest candidates: in scratch builds Level 8 (harvest) 83 of 91 candidates over 0.45 (median longest phase 0.556), Level 13 (bulk order) 56 of 71 (median 0.493), Level 16 (shelter) 24 of 62 (median 0.424); the long phase is the collect-and-sell loop running to the end. maxPhaseShare 0.60 would pass 77%/88%/76%, 0.65 would pass 96-99%. The limit waits on Doug. Within-level play shape (outpost-ops#151): no phase (gap between consecutive play-shape beat ticks, the first from 0, the last to the level end) over maxPhaseShare of the level; at least minBeatTypes first-occurrence beat types (minBeatTypesShort when under shortSeconds); some play-shape beat after newBeatAfterShare of the level. exempt: level ids never checked.
